encoder_rationale: PCA passes the archived mean acceptance gate in both arms; selected before new outcomes
means: reuse new E2 fitted means and per-cell dispersions
allocation: shared per-gene theta is median validation theta; per-cell-type theta is median validation theta within type, with global fallback below20validationcells; per-cell theta is decoder output; no test targets used to allocate theta
marker_support: same1250targetgenesinbotharms; ArmA decoder predicts fullpanel but outputs restricted to the targetgenes for every E1 endpoint; ArmB encoder never saw targetgenes; within-dataset Welch and AUROC recall@50 with type>=20testcells
tstr: mirror archived pooled multinomial logistic regression, log1p counts, C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=300; random equal halves of test cells using fit seed; train synthetic first half, evaluate real second half
rare: fewer than50cells in full held-out test split; report masked and full-support rare F1
primary_biological_contrast: per-cell minus Poisson Welch marker recall; macro-F1 and unmasked rare-F1 are separate outcomes, AUROC and masked rare-F1 sensitivity

inference.aggregation: average seed effects within dataset, then equal-weight dataset mean; percentile95%clusterbootstrap; two-sided signflip permutation; all3seeds also separately reported
inference.classification_unit: mean within-dataset F1 of the pooled classifier, distinct from pooled whole-corpus F1; report both; rare labels restricted to predefined rare identities present in that dataset evaluation set

calibration: also report primary calibration contrast to determine whether a biological result supports the same endpoint
comparison_scope: both arms use the same new MLP training recipe but retain their original output sizes; every biological endpoint uses identical1250gene support; not an exact reproduction of the earlier scVI ArmA experiment
retention: all variants and seeds retained; no outcome-based filtering
interaction: paired dataset difference of per-cell-minus-Poisson effects in Arm B versus Arm A, averaged over all three seeds; same cluster bootstrap and sign-flip test; separates arm interaction from separate significance tests
tstr_macro_support: fixed true-class support within each evaluation dataset; pooled descriptive scores use all true evaluation classes; predictions outside support still count as false negatives
secondary_marker_dose_response: negative mean log2 validation Poisson variance ratio on the same1250genes, independently drawn using SeedSequence([seed,202]); match validation/test groups with>=20cells; PCA-only regression with arm and seed effects and dataset random intercept;2000datasetbootstrapresamples
